title: Local transfer timer can stop permanently after the tab is hidden
steps: Start the local transfer window at 15:00.
While the Transfer Challenge screen is still open, hide or background the tab before the deadline.
The next timer tick sees document.visibilityState === hidden, stops transferTimerInterval and returns.
Return to the same tab after the original deadline without navigating away and reopening the Transfer Challenge.
expected: The timer resumes or immediately reconciles the deadline, shows 00:00 and moves the challenge to Guess Entry.
actual: This file has no visibilitychange restart. The local challenge can remain status active with a stale clock after return until another action reopens/reconciles it or the player manually ends the window.
root_cause: updateTransferTimer stops the interval whenever the document is hidden, but initializeTransferChallenge does not register a visibilitychange handler and synchronizeTransferDeadline is only called when openTransferChallenge runs.
checked_against: js/productionSharedTransferChallenge.js:299-301 handles visibility return for the shared path by clearing the clock and ticking again.
js/transferChallenge.js:377-394 reconciles an expired deadline only when openTransferChallenge is called.

fix.change: Add a visibilitychange handler for the local transfer engine. On visible, reconcile the current challenge deadline and restart the timer loop only when the Transfer Challenge screen is active.

assumptions: The local/legacy transferChallenge.js path is still a supported normal-play path. If production always routes every current Showdown through productionSharedTransferChallenge.js, this finding does not affect current shared play and should be closed.
